name: fastapi-deterministic-request-outcome-journal
instr:
Give FastAPI applications a deterministic outcome journal that follows each HTTP request or WebSocket session through every phase that can affect its final result. Applications can inspect immutable completed outcomes without changing existing routing, response, exception, dependency, streaming, background-task, or WebSocket behavior.

Each invocation has one opaque identity, an insertion-ordered zero-based contiguous event sequence, and exactly one terminal event shared by its immutable snapshot. Completion waits for all effective work, including stream iteration, generator-dependency teardown, and ordered background execution, so late failures remain attributed to their phases and every observed failure remains chronologically visible. HTTP handling records endpoint, conversion, response, and failure causality while preserving caller-visible responses and exceptions; WebSocket handling instead distinguishes connection, acceptance, validation rejection, application closure, cancellation, and transport failure. Generator dependencies record acquisition and teardown as paired phases while preserving their effective function or request lifetime and cache behavior; background-task abort behavior, emitted-item counts, and externally delivered exceptions remain unchanged. `OutcomeJournal.snapshot(self)` returns the completed outcome, while `current_outcome_journal()` returns the active request journal or `None` outside one.
